purpose: Form DIR-3C relates to the allotment of DIN and processing of applications under Rule 10 of the Companies Rules.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Submit Form DIR-3 on the portal
Pay the requisite amount of fees through online mode
Await Central Government processing, approval, or rejection
Rectify defects or incompleteness by resubmitting within fifteen days if intimated
checklist: Ensure Form DIR-3 is ready for portal submission
Arrange online payment for requisite fees
Check for security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs if the applicant is a national of a country sharing a land border with India
attachments: Necessary security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (if applying as a national of a country which shares land border with India)
watch: Fees paid will neither be refunded nor adjusted in case of rejection or invalidation.
